# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read the root `AGENTS.md` before working on this project.

For Typst work:
- Inspect the existing template before creating new functions or styles.
- Preserve the report's established visual direction.
- Keep meeting-specific content and metadata inside `meetings/`.
- Keep reusable layout and styling inside `template/`.
- Do not fabricate academic sources or practical evidence.
- Compile the affected report when possible and report the validation result.

Use the relevant instructions under `.github/instructions/` when editing matching files.
Reusable workflows are available under `.github/prompts/`.
